final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ordervault, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.ordervault, step1.record_count, 1.0 * step1.record_count / step2.total_count AS ratio FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.ordervault, step3.record_count, step3.ratio, step3.record_count - step4.avg_count AS difference FROM step3 JOIN step4 ON step4.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE step3.record_count > step4.avg_count) SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_counts, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM step5
